title: Gary Nolan's strontium UFO metamaterial sample

tellings.quote: isn't strontium I believe is one of Gary Nolan's pieces that he has at the you know Stanford lab that he thinks might be UFO metamaterials that come from crashes I believe has strontium in it

plain: Michels says, hedging with "I believe", that one of the samples the scientist Garry Nolan keeps at his Stanford lab, which Nolan thinks might be UFO metamaterials, meaning specially structured materials, recovered from crashes, contains strontium. Michels brings it up himself without naming a source, linking it to the element under discussion.
